goals.label: Agrees with the team, before starting, who does what plus what they deliver, who checks, and how they work
One person answers Harper, with a backup, all questions routed to them, or a shared record
Asks both finalists about real past situations and compares them the same way

objectives.text: Your team takes over Harper in three weeks. Tell Rebecca how you'll get your team ready.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives Rebecca any answer on how they'll get the team started on Harper: an up-front plan of any size, 'we'll figure it out as we go', or even a vague 'I'll make sure the team is ready', and Rebecca accepts it or moves on to the two different answers Harper got; false for a bare okay, a question alone, or Rebecca's words alone.

objectives.text: Harper got two different answers from your team. Agree with Rebecca how to make sure Harper gets one clear answer.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives any direction on how to handle replies to Harper: agreeing to copy Rebecca, 'be more careful', one person answering, a shared record, or sending the right date, and Rebecca accepts it or moves on to the new hire; false for a bare okay, an apology alone, a question alone, or Rebecca's words alone.

objectives.text: You're interviewing two finalists tomorrow. Tell Rebecca how you'll choose.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives any answer on how they'll choose: picking the first finalist, 'see who fits', or any interview plan, and Rebecca accepts it or the call closes; false for a bare okay or Rebecca's words alone.
